_comment: The only hand-edited input to the generated artwork. See DESIGN.md.
_theme: Identity, in one place. KDE wants it in three metadata files and the installer wants it in a Go const; all four are written from here so they cannot drift.

theme.name: Vanilla Box Dark
theme.author: Sizwe
theme.description: A minimal, modern look — dark variant

_foreground: Text does not follow the tint. Warm text on a blue surface reads as a mistake rather than a variant, and holding it still keeps every tint recognisably the same theme.
_surfaces: Hand-tuned per set rather than derived: a computed hue shift misbehaves at the lightness of the view background. Named separately from the palettes because two palettes share the grey set.
_palettes: A palette is a surface set and the accent that goes with it, chosen together so the two never have to be reconciled by the user. Accents match their surfaces in temperature: the variant should read as one decision, not two. Neutral and Ash share the grey surfaces and differ only in whether anything on screen is coloured at all.
_buttonStyles: Two treatments, not one with different values. Glyph buttons show a symbol always and gain a plate on hover; circle buttons show no symbol ever and gain colour on hover. Traffic-light colours are muted: authentic macOS values would be the most saturated pixels in the theme by a wide margin. Sizes were tuned by eye against a real titlebar: glyphSize is in rendered pixels, circleRadius is in 24x24 tile units and so scales with the button box. TestTitlebarButtonMetrics pins both.
